definitions.explanation: A polite way to refer to someone else's home. The prefix ご adds respect. Used in business, customer service, and formal speech.

examples.japanese: ご{自宅|じたく}までお{届|とど}けします。
examples.english: We will deliver it to your home.

examples.japanese: ご{自宅|じたく}の{住所|じゅうしょ}を{教|おし}えていただけますか。
examples.english: Could you tell me your home address?

examples.japanese: {商品|しょうひん}はご{自宅|じたく}に{直接|ちょくせつ}{配送|はいそう}いたしますので、{店頭|てんとう}でお{受|う}け{取|と}りいただく{必要|ひつよう}はございません。
examples.english: The product will be delivered directly to your home, so there is no need to pick it up at the store.

notes:
The honorific prefix ご attached to {自宅|じたく} (one's own home). This is a standard polite form used to refer to someone else's home in formal and business contexts. It is never used to refer to one's own home — that would be {自宅|じたく} without the ご prefix.

This word is extremely common in customer service, delivery services, medical offices, and formal correspondence.

USAGE:
- Use ご{自宅|じたく} when referring to someone else's home (respectful)
- Use {自宅|じたく} when referring to your own home (humble/neutral)
- The pattern parallels other ご-prefix honorifics: ご{住所|じゅうしょ}, ご{家族|かぞく}, ご{連絡|れんらく}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{自宅|じたく}に{届|とど}ける: to deliver to someone's home
- ご{自宅|じたく}にお{伺|うかが}いする: to visit someone's home (humble)
- ご{自宅|じたく}の{電話番号|でんわばんごう}: your home phone number
- ご{自宅|じたく}でのケア: home care (medical)

RELATED TERMS:
- {自宅|じたく}: one's home (neutral/plain)
- お{宅|たく}: your home (polite, also used for "your household")
- ご{住所|じゅうしょ}: your address (honorific)
